# GHD Agency

> GHD Agency finds the revenue sleeping inside a business, builds the systems that capture it, and trains the team to run them. Founded by Rich Diaz. Based in Henderson, Nevada, serving businesses across the United States.

GHD calls the sleeping, unclaimed revenue inside a business the "Sleeping Giant". The agency goes after it with a three-step engagement and hands the owner a system they own.

## How it works
- Vidian Method: a complimentary one-on-one session using proprietary software that shows where opportunities are being missed and what it is costing, measured in time and dollars.
- The Prince Charming pilot: a two-week pilot test that pressure tests the outcome before anyone commits. A $500 Setup Deposit is refunded if there are no results and applied to the build if GHD proceeds.
- The Build: a custom system for the business with the data analytics to prove results. Starting at $3,000.
- The Helm: the custom dashboard the owner's team uses to run the system.

## Who it is for
Owner-led businesses with a customer list, someone to take the calls the system creates, and capacity to serve more customers. Industries served: auto dealerships, optometry and vision care, elective aesthetics, trades and home services.

## Data and security
Every account built is in the client's name. Nothing high-stakes goes out without client approval. Customers opt in and every message honors STOP. GHD can build to HIPAA requirements when the business needs it.
